interpretation.timing_population: total/setup/solve stats use passed calls; all returned timings and every outcome remain separate
interpretation.deltas: sum only the same field across disjoint attempts of the same kernel; fallback namespaces remain separate
interpretation.timers: inclusive/nested and sometimes concurrent; phase times must not be added together
interpretation.snapshot_metadata: constructor and cached-build times describe retained objects; repeated warm snapshots are not new work
interpretation.factor_entries: allocated sparse factor values including padding, not exact nnz(L); matrix nnz is full assembled CSR
interpretation.local_factors: within local-factor shapes and cross-tab sparsity are not a factor-nnz or flop measurement
interpretation.symbolic_flops: symbolic work estimate, not instrumented floating-point operations
interpretation.ratios: descriptive paired ratios at equal recorded controls; no significance claim or strong ranking
interpretation.toggle: hot-loop counters/timers only; both modes retain metadata and snapshot generation
